title: Chill-Proof

{{Infobox Mechanic |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Cold Resistance Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Cold Resistance Icon.png |Sprite EoW= File:EoW Chill-Proof Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK, EoW |other= |purpose= |related= {{List| * [[Added Effect]] * [[Armor]] * [[Cooking]] * [[Freezing Climate]] }} }} {{Term/Store|Chill-Proof||Series, EoW}},{{Exp Game|EoW}} also known as {{Term/Store|Cold Resistance||BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}=== Cold Resistance is an [[Added Effect]] that prevents [[Link]] from taking damage due to [[Freezing Climate]]s. Some environments require a higher Effect level. This Effect does not affect damage taken from [[Ice]], Ice-based attacks, or [[Cold Water]], and it has a maximum potency of level two. In {{BotW}}, the following [[Material]]s and [[Armor]] pieces grant Cold Resistance: {{Gallery List|Items |BotW= Spicy Pepper, Sunshroom, Warm Safflina, Sizzlefin Trout, Summerwing Butterfly, Warm Darner }} {{Gallery List|Items |BotW= Warm Doublet, Snowquill Headdress, Snowquill Tunic, Snowquill Trousers, Vah Medoh Divine Helm, Ruby Circlet }} The following [[Material]]s and [[Armor]] pieces grant Cold Resistance in {{TotK}}: {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Spicy Pepper, Sunshroom, Warm Safflina, Sizzlefin Trout, Summerwing Butterfly, Warm Darner }} {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Archaic Warm Greaves, Snowquill Headdress, Snowquill Tunic, Snowquill Trousers, Vah Medoh Divine Helm, Ruby Circlet }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== In {{EoW}}, Chill-Proof is an [[Added Effect]] that prevents [[Princess Zelda]] from taking damage in the [[Freezing Climate]] caused by the [[Blizzard]] on [[Hebra Mountain]]. She is also immune to damage from [[Cold Water]]. It can be obtained by drinking [[Smoothie]]s and [[Potion]]s with "Warm" in their names, which are made using [[Warm Pepper]]s. Like [[Link]] in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, Zelda is still vulnerable to [[Ice]] attacks while Chill-Proof is active. The following drinks grant Chill-Proof: {{Data Table |game= EoW |columns= Drink[Image][Link], Chill-Proof Duration |- | Warm Smoothie | 1:00 |- | Warm Mixed Smoothie | 1:00 |- | Warm Rocktato Smoothie | 3:00 |- | Warm Mixed Special | 1:00 |- | Warming Potion | 5:00 }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Added Effect * Freezing Climate * Ice-Proof }} {{Ref| {{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}} {{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}} {{Cite|{{Icon|EoW Chill-Proof}} Chill-Proof 1:00|Game Screen|EoW}} {{Cite|{{Big|{{Color EoW|Pink|Warm Pepper}}}}
